# Burlesque To Go

> Las Vegas burlesque entertainment on demand — classy tease-not-strip performances delivered to private events, with a roster of professional dancers, aerialists and specialty acts.

Founded by Fawnia Dietrich. Performances from $150; booking by SMS at 702-205-1440. The aim is to tease and insinuate, never to expose — burlesque as theatrical art.

## Pages

- [Dancers](/dancers): Meet the full roster of performers
- [What Is Burlesque?](/what-is-burlesque): The art form explained
- [FAQ](/faq): Booking, pricing and event questions
- [Book](/book): Book a performance by SMS or form

- [Bachelorette Pole Dancing Parties](https://www.bachelorettepoledancingparties.com): bachelorette pole dancing parties in Las Vegas
- [I Love Pole Because](https://ilovepolebecause.com): community stories about why people love pole dancing
- [The Melissa Foundation](https://themelissafoundation.org): nonprofit sharing health and wellness resources for people before, during and after cancer
